tools.name: find_dog_friendly_places
tools.description: Find places in London listed on Paws of London as somewhere to take a dog: pubs, cafes, restaurants, hotels and shops, plus dog services (vets, groomers, pet shops, daycare, trainers). Filter by type, by area (a borough, neighbourhood or station name) or near a postcode with a radius, by recorded am

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: Everything Paws of London lists for one place: address, website, types, dog policy with how it was checked and any restrictions, every recorded amenity, opening hours, whether it is open now (London time) and nearby stations. Pass the place URL or its id from find_dog_friendly_places. Read-only.

tools.name: list_coverage
tools.description: How many places Paws of London lists, by type and by London borough and neighbourhood, and the amenity filters find_dog_friendly_places accepts. Read-only.
